reviews.review_description:
Verily, I say unto thee, seldom hath mine eyes beheld a game of such wondrous quality and boundless delight! From the very moment one entereth its realm, there awaiteth adventure, merriment, and countless hours of joyous entertainment. Every corner seemeth crafted with care, and each passing moment bringeth forth yet another reason to remain and play.

Great praise must also be bestowed upon the noble owner, whose dedication and labour hath brought this magnificent creation unto life. Truly, such devotion deserveth admiration, for it is no small feat to fashion a game capable of bringing such great enjoyment unto its players. The owner hath done a most splendid deed, and for this, I offer mine highest respect.

As for the enjoyment of the game—by my troth, it is tremendous! Never doth the experience grow dull, nor doth the spirit tire of the adventures that await. Laughter, excitement, and good cheer accompany thee throughout, making the passing of hours feel but like fleeting minutes.

Therefore, let it be known throughout all the lands: this game is a most excellent creation, its owner a worthy and admirable soul, and the enjoyment found within it greater than words may easily describe. I heartily commend it unto all who seeketh entertainment and good times.

Long may this glorious game prosper, and long may its creator continue their noble work!

I played the game for around an hour and explored the map. The quality of this game is pretty great, especially the glass smashing feature. It's really fun to just run up to a wall of glass and smash right through it. Lots of opportunities for skits. Some of the problems I have with the game is that sometimes when I try to run, I stick to the floor, similar to what used to happen in Monkey Buds. Along with the monsters being a bit fast, it keeps chases short. I do like the amount of memes riddled around the map and the fact that this game doesn't have any paid options that give you an advantage. Though there's not much content yet, it's still pretty fun to play and has lots of potential.
